title: SculptSoft HR / Careers Contact
meta_description: Contact details for SculptSoft's HR team for career and job application queries.
clean_text:
SculptSoft does not publish a separate dedicated HR phone line. For HR and career-related queries (job applications, interviews, hiring process), candidates can reach SculptSoft through the company's general contact channels:
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 99099 53970
Email: info@sculptsoft.com
Careers page: https://www.sculptsoft.com/career
SculptSoft's hiring process typically involves an initial conversation with the HR team to understand the candidate's background and expectations, followed by a technical evaluation round.
